definitions.explanation: A boat or ship used commercially or traditionally for catching fish and other seafood.

examples.japanese: {漁船|ぎょせん}が{港|みなと}に{戻|もど}ってきた。
examples.english: The fishing boats returned to the harbor.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さな{漁船|ぎょせん}が{朝早|あさはや}く{沖|おき}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: A small fishing boat went out to sea early in the morning.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{近|ちか}づいているため、すべての{漁船|ぎょせん}が{港|みなと}に{避難|ひなん}している。
examples.english: All fishing boats have taken shelter in the harbor because a typhoon is approaching.

notes:
A compound of {漁|ぎょ} (fishing, as an industry) and {船|せん} (vessel, ship). This is the standard formal term for fishing boats. Japan has a long maritime tradition, and {漁船|ぎょせん} frequently appears in news reports about fishing industry, maritime incidents, and weather warnings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漁船|ぎょせん}が{沖|おき}に{出|で}る: a fishing boat goes offshore
- {漁船|ぎょせん}が{転覆|てんぷく}する: a fishing boat capsizes
- {漁船|ぎょせん}の{乗組員|のりくみいん}: fishing boat crew
- {小型|こがた}{漁船|ぎょせん}: small fishing vessel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {釣|つ}り{船|ぶね}: fishing boat — for recreational fishing charters
- {船|ふね}: boat; ship — the general word for any watercraft
- {漁|りょう}: fishing — the act of commercial fishing itself
